contribution.evidence: RESULTS Twelve percent of the tweets (n = 43) were found to contain discriminatory language.

Thematic analysis of the biased tweets identified 8 broad themes describing language-based age discrimination: assumptions and judgments, older people as different, uncharacteristic characteristics, old as negative, young as positive, infantilization, internalized ageism, and internalized microaggression.

method.evidence: DESIGN AND METHODS We conducted a qualitative study of a twitter assignment for 236 students participating in a senior mentoring program.
Three hundred fifty-four tweets were qualitatively analyzed to explore language-based age discrimination using a thematic analytic approach.
